Běh rozdělený na srovnatelné úseky podle: Each run split into comparable segments by terrain
Co dělá AI asistent?: What does the AI assistant do?
Co v aplikaci dostanete: What you get in the app
Data z hodinek a krátký deník skládá kaž: Every day it turns your watch data and a short diary into one clear state, measured against your own norm. It tells you how much you can take on today and, when it is time to slow down or see a physiotherapist, explains why.
Došlap není zdravotnický prostředek a ne: Došlap is not a medical device and does not make a diagnosis. It shows changes against your own norm; the decision stays with you and the professionals.
Funguje s hodinkami i bez nich: Works with or without a watch
Fyzioterapeut je uvidí až ve chvíli, kdy: A physiotherapist sees them only once you confirm you want care and they take on your case.
Fyzioterapeut, když je potřeba: A physiotherapist when you need one
Garmin i s historií, Apple Health export: Garmin including your history, Apple Health via an export from your iPhone. Without a watch you log runs by hand.
Hodnoty v hodinkách, v telefonu a v inte: Values on the watch, the phone and in the interactive demos are illustrative. © Došlap
Hotovo · první stav je připravený: Done · your first state is ready
Name, e-mail and password. It takes a minute.
Každé pravidlo má v dokumentaci zdroj a: Every rule has a source and a strength of evidence in the documentation. Where we rely on our own assumption, we say so openly and will calibrate it with data.
Každý běh zařadíme podle povrchu, sklonu: Every run is classified by surface, gradient and pace. A slow jog then doesn’t look like a change in technique, and a hilly trail doesn’t look like a jump in load.
Když se signály sčítají, Došlap doporučí: When the signals add up, Došlap recommends a consultation. A physiotherapist sees your data only once you ask for care yourself.
Mechanika, zátěž, příznaky a připravenos: Mechanics, load, symptoms and readiness, always against your own norm from recent weeks, not against other people’s average.
Projděte si celou aplikaci na ukázkovém: Explore the whole app on a demo runner
Proč dnes nemám dělat intervaly?: Why shouldn’t I do intervals today?
Průvodce vás provede aplikací a první st: A guide walks you through the app, and you see your first state as soon as the data load.
Průvodce vás provede prvními kroky: A guide walks you through the first steps
Před třemi dny jste běželi úsilí blízké: Three days ago you ran a near-race effort. Take one more day without intensity; an easy 6–8 km run fits.
Sign in with your e-mail and password.
Připojte hodinky jednou a data budou při: Connect your watch once and the data flow in by themselves. Your history loads too, so your norm builds from day one. Without a watch you start with the diary.
Připojte hodinky, nebo začněte deníkem: Connect your watch, or start with the diary
Půl roku běhů, deník, program od fyziote: Six months of runs, the diary, a physiotherapist’s programme and the AI assistant. No sign-up, read-only, with a guide.
Ráno se podívejte na svůj stav: Check your state in the morning
Ráno víte, v jakém jste stavu a kolik to: In the morning you know your state and how much you can take on today: session type, kilometres, heart rate, pace and elevation.
Tep, HRV, spánek a běžecká dynamika přit: Heart rate, HRV, sleep and running dynamics flow in from Garmin or Apple Health, history included. Without a watch, a short diary is enough.
U každého čísla vidíte, co ho tvoří, jak: For every number you see what makes it up, how strong the evidence is and how many points it costs.
Vaše data vidíte jen vy, dokud nepožádát: Only you see your data until you ask for care
Vaše data vidíte vy: Your data are yours to see
Vidím skok v klesání. Tento týden zkraťt: I can see the jump in descent. Shorten the long run this week and we’ll look at your technique on Thursday.
Vysvětluje vaše skóre, limity a doporuče: It explains your score, limits and recommendations from the numbers the app calculated and from the research it cites. If an answer would contradict the calculation, you get an answer built by fixed rules instead.
Vysvětlí skóre, limity i doporučení: Explains the score, limits and recommendations
Zabere to minutu, pak vás provede průvod: It takes a minute, then a guide takes you through.
Zeptejte se, proč vám aplikace dnes nedo: Ask why the app doesn’t recommend intervals today. The assistant answers from your data and from the research literature, and names its source.
